jobs.occupation: Welder - Semi-automatic or TIG – Zwevegem – 2 Shift
jobs.description:
Title
Welder – Two-Shift Work
Job description
Looking for a full-time welding role in automotive parts manufacturing? This opportunity in Zwevegem starts as an interim assignment with the option of permanent employment. You’ll work with tube products and a range of materials.
A tube-products manufacturer
The company specializes in manufacturing tube products.
Your role
• Weld aluminum, stainless steel, and iron to create strong, precise joints.
• Carry out accurate welding work on tubes for different applications.
• Use TIG or semi-automatic welding equipment for the work at hand.
• Check your work carefully and make sure the finish meets quality specifications.
You’ll work in a two-shift schedule.
Company profile
Forum Jobs connects talent and companies through a personal approach and broad sector knowledge. As a full-service HR partner, it supports both candidates and employers, bringing a human touch to the recruitment process and helping people find opportunities that fit.

You’ll feel at home in this role if careful, skilled welding and pride in a quality finish are your kind of work.

• Your experience as a welder gives you a solid foundation, especially if you’ve worked with aluminum, stainless steel, and iron.
• TIG welding feels familiar to you, and you’re comfortable working with semi-automatic welding equipment.
• You notice the small details that make a difference and take pride in delivering high-quality work.
• You enjoy working as part of a team, adapt flexibly, and make safety a priority for yourself and those around you.
• You can communicate in English, Dutch, or French, and can provide a reference from a former employer.

Do you have a passion for technology and are you looking for a challenging job with responsibility?Become a bending machine operator in an innovative production environment! You'll bend pipes of various sizes, cut them to length where needed, and remove burrs. The work can be physically demanding, especially with larger pipes. Experience in the metal industry is a strong plus.

What are you tasks?

• 
Operate and set up the bending machine to ensure precise pipe shaping.

• 
Monitor the process and intervene in case of malfunctions to guarantee a perfect end product.

• 
2-shift system!

Dutch and/or English language skills are required.

Your profile:

• 
You have technical knowledge or experience in a similar role.

• 
Accuracy and attention to detail are your strong suits.

• 
You are eager to learn and interested in automation and production processes.

• 
You can work independently, but also thrive in a team environment.

• 
Safety and quality are always your top priorities.

Do you combine deep cybersecurity expertise with architectural judgement to turn complex requirements into secure, scalable and supportable solutions? As Security Solution Architect, part of our Security & Networking Architecture team, you are a senior, customer-facing technical authority with deep expertise in one or more security domains. You own solution architecture and design authority from discovery through delivery, translating business, risk and security requirements into practical target architectures, high-level designs and implementation guidance. You work directly on customer engagements and provide specialist architecture expertise to opportunities led by the Solution Pre-Sales team.

 

• You lead customer discovery, architecture workshops and technical decision forums to clarify requirements, constraints, dependencies and risks.
• Define target architectures, principles, standards, patterns, high-level designs and implementation guidance for secure, resilient and operable solutions.
• Act as design authority, governing design decisions, reviewing solution artefacts and managing exceptions and technical debt.
• Guide engineering and project teams through implementation, validate detailed designs and runbooks, resolve architectural issues and confirm alignment with the approved design.
• Identify and treat security, integration, technology and operational risks using security-by-design, least privilege, defence-in-depth, resilience and lifecycle principles.
• Provide validated solution architecture inputs to the Solution Pre-Sales team, including technical designs, options, assumptions, dependencies, risks and delivery estimates.
• Partner with Product Management to evolve services, reference architectures, blueprints, patterns, costing models and industry-specific propositions.
• Maintain reusable architecture assets, coach colleagues and contribute to technology-partner relationships and team capability.
What you need to succeed:
• Substantial experience designing and delivering enterprise security solutions, with senior-level technical credibility and customer-facing experience.
• Deep expertise in at least one domain such as IT or OT protection, cloud security, SOC and exposure management, identity security, or data and AI security.
• Broad understanding of networking, infrastructure, cloud, applications, identity, data, security operations, integration and operational service management.
• Demonstrated ability to produce and govern high-level designs and review detailed designs, implementation plans and operational documentation.
• Experience supporting dedicated presales teams with architecture, effort and cost inputs, assumptions, dependencies and risks, and explaining technical choices to customer stakeholders.
• Strong architectural thinking, technical leadership, consulting, communication and collaboration skills, with sound commercial awareness.
• Excellent written and spoken English; relevant vendor or professional certifications and additional languages are assets.
• Relevant higher education or equivalent professional experience in cybersecurity, computer science, engineering, infrastructure or architecture.

Do you like to conduct application penetration testing and identify vulnerabilities?  Would you like to proactively perform threat modeling for new and existing applications?

 

• Application Penetration Testing: You will perform manual and automated application penetration testing against web applications,  APIs and mobile applications to identify vulnerabilities, business logic flaws and chained attack vectors
• Threat Modeling: You will lead threat modeling sessions, using methodologies like STRIDE and PASTA to identify, analyze and prioritize threats in application architectures
• Security Assessments: You will conduct comprehensive application architecture, source code reviews and vulnerability assessments to validate security controls
• Remediation Guidance: You will collaborate with developers and product teams to explain complex vulnerabilities, provide actionable remediation guidance and verify security fixes
• Detection Engineering: You will provide our Detection Engineering team with propositions for the development of detection logic to increase coverage of our application security monitoring practice
• Tooling: You will leverage penetration testing tools (Burp Suite Pro, OWASP ZAP, …) and develop scripts (Python, Bash, …) to automate testing tasks and improve efficiency. You will develop data flow diagrams (MS Threat Modeling Tool, OWASP Threat Dragon, …) and research new application security solutions to add to our toolkit.
What you need to succeed:
• You have at least 3+ years of recent hands-on experience in application penetration testing and threat modeling
• You have proven experience in conducting and facilitating threat modeling workshops and integrating threat modeling into the SDLC
• You have a deep understanding of OWASP ASVS, web/mobile app security and cloud security architectures (AWS, Azure and GCP) as well as threat modeling methodologies like STRIDE, PASTA, …
• You have a degree in Computer Sciences, Information Security or equivalent by experience
• Certifications like GWAPT, GXPN, GMOB, Burp Suite Certified Practitioner, OSWA, OSWE, … are highly appreciated
• You are able to coordinate penetration testing and threat modeling assignments, as well as translating complex technical findings into actionable reports for stakeholders
• You work collaboratively with cross-functional teams (developers, application owners, managers, …) in a fast-paced environment
• You have excellent written and verbal communication skills in English and Dutch. Knowledge of French is a plus
• You preferably work two days per week from our office in Hasselt (Universiteitslaan), combined with working from home.

Our client is a well-established international organisation operating in a fast-paced and data-driven environment. Based in Brussels, the company collaborates with stakeholders across multiple European markets and is committed to driving operational excellence through data, innovation and continuous improvement.As part of its continued growth, the organisation is looking to strengthen its analytics capabilities by hiring a Business Analyst / Data Analyst who will play a key role in supporting business operations and strategic decision-making.

As a Data Analyst, you will support business and operational teams by ensuring accurate reporting, reliable data management and insightful performance analysis.Your main responsibilities will include:

• Developing and maintaining reporting tools, dashboards and performance indicators.
• Collecting, validating, consolidating and analysing data from various sources.
• Producing business performance reports and providing actionable recommendations to management.
• Supporting the automation, standardisation and optimisation of data processes.
• Building analytical tools to facilitate data-driven decision-making.
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of systems, processes and reporting methodologies
• Working closely with international stakeholders across different business functions.
• Participating in cross-functional projects related to operations, performance management, data governance and business development.

We are looking for a professional with approximately 2 to 3 years of experience in Data Analysis, Business Analysis, Reporting, Commercial Controlling or a similar analytical role.Key qualifications and competencies include:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.
• Previous experience working with data analysis and performance reporting.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Experience with SQL and data management tools.
• Knowledge of Power BI or similar Business Intelligence solutions is considered a strong asset.
• Strong analytical mindset with a passion for turning data into meaningful business insights.
• Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
• Professional proficiency in English and French.

Role description

The Cyber Security Incident Response Team is a centralized security service, responsible for managing cyber security incidents within the Proximus Group. The team is responsible for delivering all relevant services to mitigate an incident as quickly and efficient as possible and to keep (higher) management updated on the progress.

As an Incident Response Specialist in the CSIRT you are responsible to respond to cyber security incidents when they occur. Your main objective is to respond effectively and work together with the technical teams within the different business unit within Proximus.

Role:

• You have end-to-end responsibility for coordination of cyber incidents that are being reported by internal or external sources, including: prioritize incidents, identify key people in system teams, organize crisis meetings, send notification alerts to key stakeholders, perform complex incident analysis, perform forensic investigation where applicable, document analysis findings, perform research on threat actor, share and discuss threat information with team and liaise with press team in case of public exposure.
• You provide expert support to the team that monitors security alerts (Cyber Defence Center).
• You are responsible for collecting and generating statistical incident information, build reporting, regularly present reporting information to higher management.
• You liaise with 3rd parties (other telecom operators, security actors, equipment vendors…) to gather intelligence about emerging threats and vulnerabilities. Take appropriate actions accordingly with relevant teams, in order to limit risk and exposure for Proximus.
• You initiate and participate in expert reviews with engineering and monitoring teams in order to improve security architecture for critical environments, monitoring tools, security processes, cyber defence strategy, etc.
• You proactively propose improvement actions for IT/Network to reduce/prevent cyber incidents, and perform follow-up until implementation.
• You provide input for mitigation plan.

Profile:

• Bachelor’s in Computer science/ Information security or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• CISSP, CISM, CISA, CEH, CHFI certificates are considered high value.
• You have in-depth knowledge of Internet technology and protocols.
• You are an expert in security vulnerabilities/weaknesses and related attacks.
• You have a good knowledge of scripting languages (Perl, PHP, Python, shell…).
• You are flexible and a strong team player.
• You have great communication skills and experience in participating in (inter)national security information sharing groups.
• You show integrity & trust while managing confidential information.
• Experience within telecommunications environment and technologies is considered of high value.
• Mastering English is a must for the position. Speaking French and/or Dutch is a plus.
• You are ready to work and respond to incidents outside of business hours.
 

**Applicants must enjoy full rights as Belgian citizens or have been living for 5 years in Belgium to be considered for this role.**

• Organize and coordinate testing activities across various organizational entities.

Requirements

• 5+ years of expertise in quality assurance and Integration Testing.
• 5+ years of hands-on experience with JIRA for test tracking and coordination.
• 5+ years of experience with Test Automation frameworks and methodologies.
• 3+ years of proficiency in SQL for data validation.
• You bring a proven track record in defining and implementing complex test strategies.
• You have the ability to produce structured documentation and reporting for diverse stakeholders.
• You possess strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a proactive mindset.
• You are a Native speaker of Dutch and are fluent in French and English.
Nice to Haves

• Previous experience in complex transformation or merger programs.
• Familiarity with infrastructure migration requirements and planning.

We are looking for experienced pharmaceutical professionals who want to actively contribute to the future of medicine. This is more than just a job, it is an opportunity to further develop your expertise and grow your career in a dynamic, mission-driven environment focused on patient impact.
 

If you already have experience in cleanroom operations, pharmaceutical manufacturing or chemical processes, or if you combine a relevant educational background with hands-on experience, we would very much like to hear from you.
 

Your role and responsibilities;
 
 
 
• Actively participate in aseptic and manual pharmaceutical manufacturing processes. 
 
• Work in cleanroom and laboratory environments in accordance with GMP standards. 
 
• Perform production activities in controlled environments (Grade A/B/C/D), including spiking, media exchanges, cell culture activities and freezing of therapeutic products. 
 
• Execute thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials and equipment. 
 
• Support transitions between production zones, ensuring compliance and continuity. 
 
 

This role is suited for you if you:
 

 
• Have relevant pharmaceutical experience or a Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences.
 
• Have experience in a cleanroom, pharmaceutical, or chemical environment.
 
• Enjoy working in a structured environment and following procedures.
 
• Communicate fluently in English.

Start your career in Pharma in a Lab Support role!
 

Are you ready to make a real impact in the world of biotechnology? 
 

 
 

Are you detail-oriented and comfortable working in a rapid changing, clean environment with very strict procedures? Do you want to contribute to the production of innovative, life-saving cell therapies? Then this could be the opportunity for you.
 

After extensive training in aseptic working and Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), you’ll join our Operations Team and support the production of the Carvykti treatment in a highly controlled cleanroom environment.
 

What You’ll Do
 

 
• Support the daily aseptic and manual production process, following strict procedures and quality standards.
 
• Prepare workstations, equipment, tools and materials for production.
 
• Clean and disinfect materials and equipment to maintain a sterile environment.
 
• Inspect equipment and ensure the correct transfer of materials between production zones.
 
• Work closely with operators and team leads to ensure the timely delivery of high-quality therapies to patients. 
 

Good to Know You’ll work in a sterile environment wearing protective clothing. This role follows a shift schedule including weekends. Full training is provided.

We are looking for you if:
 

 
• You live near Gent/Zwijnaarde or have reliable transportation such as bike or Car.
 
• Fluent in English, you thrive in teamwork and are eager to learn new skills.
 
• You are accountable and motivated to make a difference in patient's lives. 
 
• Your attention to detail is unmatched.
 
• Bonus points for familiarity with GMP standards, aseptic techniques, sterilization methods, and MS Office.

Our client, Legend Biotech, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company bringing the innovative CAR-T cell therapy to Ghent. With this, the Legend Biotech team makes a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases.They are currently in a phase of strong growth and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.
